trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn all other 54 trophies to unlock the platinum Leonida Legend trophy. Plan your playthrough around missable chapter missions and side activities.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the opening prologue mission 'Gone Fishing' introducing Jason and Lucia in Vice City.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete all narrative operations in Chapter 1 establishing the crew's operational base.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Note: Certain side interactions in this chapter are missable if you progress too fast before opening free roam.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 as the narrative shifts deeper into Vice City's underground syndicates.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 leading up to the climax of the main campaign.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final campaign mission. Ensure manual saves before the point of no return to avoid locking out specific choices.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission 'Breakfast Run'. Follow your partner carefully during the timed getaway.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete 'The Cartel Heist'. Coordinate timing and team roles for optimal score.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete 'Child's Play'. Protect family assets across the bayou.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the high-stakes music industry mission 'Headliners'.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete 'VCIA Takedown' at the airport terminal.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete 'Operation Savage Glory' involving heavy military hardware.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% total game completion by finishing story, strangers, hobbies, and random events across Leonida.
steps: Track completion stats in pause menu

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Successfully complete 250 stunt jumps scattered across Vice City and the surrounding countryside.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 distinct activity types at least once (e.g., racing, shooting range, bowling, arcade, fishing, drone racing, meditation, hunting, yoga).

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold medals across all 42 Shooting Range challenges by mastering weapon accuracy and target reload speeds.
steps: Beat gold target scores on all 42 courses

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 designated map locations.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different street and track races across Leonida.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge down at the Keys docks.
steps: Catch heavier fish within time limit

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play and complete a full arcade game cabinet in the local arcade or safehouse.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Missable if you ignore stranger strands before end-game.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Missable prior to chapter close.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Missable during Act 2.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 distinct stranger mission strands across the state of Leonida before story lockouts.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Missable if ignored during mid-game.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Missable side arc.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 peaceful spots across Leonida's beaches and nature reserves.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique legendary animal requested by Bret. Missable hunting side-quest.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collect and complete 3 full Collectible Card sets hidden throughout the game world.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the 'WAiNK It' social app feature at 100 distinct tourist and scenic locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 daily or milestone challenges tracked in your player log.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose an active 4-star Wanted Level while cooperating with your partner in free roam.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 convenience stores back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
steps: Flee directly to shop 2 and 3 maintaining pursuit

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover and drive 100 unique vehicle models across Leonida.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single activation of the Combat Focus ability.
steps: Trigger ability and secure 5 quick kills

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from the VCIA terminal during heist operations.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Infiltrate and deal with military Rhino tanks during high alert operations.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store in Vice City without triggering the silent alarm or being detected.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Successfully rob 5 major Bank Vaults across Leonida and escape the authorities.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Intercept and rob an Armored Cash Truck on the highway, then escape.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 distinct districts and zones of the state of Leonida.
steps: Travel across all map regions until fog of war clears

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Raid and rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 rival gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a relaxing cocktail with an ocean view at Ocean Beach.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a heavily guarded vehicle showroom in classic cinematic style.
steps: Drive car through showroom glass window

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a frameset of bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Trigger a cooperative partnership event with mass public appeal.
steps: Perform synchronized duo action in public

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make pivotal narrative choices throughout the campaign (tracked up to 500 decision points).
steps: Make choices during dialogues and missions

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a retry after failing a mission or challenge objective.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness one of the paranormal or strange occurrences hidden in the swamps and city.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock down an NPC or rival using a melee attack during a vehicle drive-by.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 in clean funds by laundering Marked Bills through criminal contacts.
steps: Use contact laundering services until $250k cleaned

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative total of $100,000 across clothing, weapon, and vehicle modification shops.
steps: Shop at various retail stores until $100k spent

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties available for acquisition across Leonida.
steps: Visit real estate broker or web

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 different vehicles to the Scooter Bros mobile app.
steps: Open Scooter Bros app on in-game phone
